description: This file defines a utility class 'InteractiveTableUtils' for managing interactive behaviors (resizing, reordering columns) in an HTML table component within a React project, including event handling for drag-and-drop and mouse interactions.

classes.name: InteractiveTableUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to enable column resizing and reordering in an HTML table, handling events such as drag-and-drop, mouse movements, and cleanup of event listeners.

methods.name: clearListeners
methods.description: Removes event listeners related to column resizing and reordering, and resets resizable and reorderable states.

methods.name: setTableRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the HTMLTableElement.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current column reference within its parent node.

methods.name: handleColumnDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a column drag event, storing the column data and setting drag data transfer.

methods.name: handleDragDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping a column, updating the columns order based on drag-and-drop.

methods.name: allowDrop
methods.description: Allows drop events by preventing default behavior.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events for initiating resize or drag actions on columns.

methods.name: handleMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events to resize columns dynamically when dragging.

methods.name: handleMouseup
methods.description: Handles mouse up events to finalize resize or drag actions.

methods.name: initializeResizableColumns
methods.description: Enables or disables column resizing by attaching or removing event listeners on table header cells.

methods.name: initializeDragDropColumns
methods.description: Enables or disables column reordering via drag-and-drop by attaching or removing event listeners on table header cells.
